unit.why: A short anecdote: the Besht asks Heaven to name the generation's greatest scholar so he can serve him, travels to the author of Tevuot Shor, hands him water for washing his hands, and leaves at once.

stories.start_quote: שמעתי ממנו ז"ל פ"א שסיפר כי הבע״שט
stories.end_quote: ומיד נסע משם ולא התראה אליו עוד
stories.summary_en: The Besht asked Heaven who the generation's great scholar was so he could serve him; told it was the author of Tevuot Shor, he travelled to him, gave him water to wash his hands as he rose from bed, and left immediately, never seeing him again.

tags.why: framed as a tale told by the author's rebbe

והשיבו לו על הגאון בעל תבואת שור

tags.why: illustrates the Besht's humility and his honour for Torah scholars
